item.title: Regulatory wars piling up in court; TDSAT turns new battleground
item.description: New Delhi: Regulatory disputes involving the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) continue to pile up across courts and tribunals, with the Telecom Disputes Settlement and Appellate Tribunal (TDSAT) emerging as an increasingly central forum for challenges, especially on broadcasting regulations. item.title: Vietnam caps unskippable online ads at 5 seconds from Feb 15, 2026
item.description: New Delhi: Vietnam has notified fresh rules to curb intrusive online advertising, capping the wait time for skipping video ads and animated sequences at five seconds from February 15, 2026. Online platforms will not be allowed to make viewers wait beyond five seconds to skip video advertisements. The regulation stated that users must be able to close static image ads without being forced to wait. item.title: How TRAI is moving from rulebook to rule-check, with DPO audits now leading to penalties
item.description: New Delhi: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) is increasingly moving from issuing frameworks to pushing compliance on the ground, with distribution platform operators (DPOs) coming under sharper scrutiny over mandatory Digital Addressable System (DAS) audits and related disclosures. TRAI’s FY25 annual report shows the regulator has already begun using enforcement levers built into the interconnection regime. item.title: Usha Bhandarkar, veteran Indian advertising leader, passes away at 82
item.description: New Delhi: Usha Bhandarkar, a pioneering figure in Indian advertising and a senior creative leader associated with several of the country’s most influential consumer brands, has passed away at the age of 82. Bhandarkar was widely respected for her contribution to shaping the voice and identity of brands such as Surf, Liril, Lifebuoy and Rexona. item.title: JioStar signs 15 sponsors for Tata WPL 2026
item.description: New Delhi: JioStar has secured a roster of 15 sponsors for the fourth edition of the Tata Women’s Premier League (WPL) 2026, scheduled to run from January 9 to February 5, 2026, as women’s cricket continues to grow as a mainstream sports and commercial property. item.title: WPP Media retains Reckitt India’s integrated media duties, adds e-commerce mandate
item.description: New Delhi: WPP Media has retained the integrated media mandate for Reckitt India, while also strengthening its partnership with the addition of the E-Commerce Media mandate. The expanded scope builds on a relationship that began in 2023. Under the renewed mandate, Wavemaker will continue to lead Reckitt’s media strategy, planning, and buying, while also spearheading the newly awarded e-commerce mandate. item.title: Amul responds after YouTube video questions Masti Dahi hygiene
item.description: New Delhi: Indian dairy giant Amul has responded to a viral video posted by YouTube creator Trustified, which claimed that its Masti Dahi product fails several quality tests. The video suggested that the pouch variant had potentially poorer hygiene or handling compared to the cup version. In a statement, Amul described the content as misinformation, stating that Masti Dahi meets all quality requirements and follows FSSAI procedures.
